relation_vocabulary.label: grounds
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Grounding explains why an invariant matters; it is not enforcement.

relation_vocabulary.label: is operationalized by
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Operationalization does not activate or adopt the rule.

relation_vocabulary.label: is classified as
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Classification does not imply authority or effect.

relation_vocabulary.label: is observed by
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: An observation is not automatically harm, semantic change, or a lifecycle event.

relation_vocabulary.label: supports
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Evidence support is not truth, authority, or decision.

relation_vocabulary.label: produces
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: A calculation result is not an owner decision or enforcement verdict.

relation_vocabulary.label: is evaluated under
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Policy evaluation yields a recommendation strategy, not authority.

relation_vocabulary.label: may inform
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: A policy may inform but cannot create its target decision.

relation_vocabulary.label: adopts exact
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The edge represents an exact owner decision; the ontology itself performs no adoption.

relation_vocabulary.label: contains rule
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Membership does not activate a candidate Constitution or Rule.

relation_vocabulary.label: contains policy
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Membership does not activate a candidate Constitution or Policy.

relation_vocabulary.label: is realized by
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: The authority artifact and its execution workflow remain distinct.

relation_vocabulary.label: coordinates
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Coordination does not decide or enforce.

relation_vocabulary.label: is scoped by
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: Authority cannot be inferred from the existence of the rule or relation.

relation_vocabulary.label: is measured by
relation_vocabulary.forbidden_collapse: A measure is not a trigger, KPI, decision, or proof that the rule is harmful.

relations.forbidden_collapse: Does not make the axiom a check or the invariant a constitution.
Does not turn kind into lifecycle or effect state.
Does not make every observation a new rule version.
Does not make the assessment authoritative.
Does not produce an owner decision.
Does not make policy recommendation a decision.
Does not create or approve a decision.
Records the relation shape but does not adopt a Constitution or select validation bindings.
Does not collapse a Discipline card into a workflow run.
Does not let the workflow decide or enforce.
Does not grant authority to the rule.
Does not turn the metric into a gate or lifecycle clock.
